coaching.headline: Good win. The early duo deaths still need cleaning up.
coaching.team: The squad took structures without losing any and secured Mini Prime despite conceding Fangtooth. The duo recovery mattered, but a win does not spray enough deodorant over the early deaths to make them disappear.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong delivered objective pressure without dying. Keep that standard, but fix the thin ward placement. Put a safe approach ward down before starting the next objective. Good pressure needs information; the win does not make that job optional.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock supplied useful kills after Mini Prime, but repeated early deaths made this a mixed game. Keep the productive pressure and review those opening deaths for one concrete adjustment. Fix that before changing items. Winning does not turn a rough opening into good play.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Greystone brought warding, objective damage and survival. That is useful work. Keep the warding; next game, place vision on safe approaches and help finish the take once the route is covered. Repeat the contribution instead of chasing a prettier scoreline.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Belica led hero damage without dying, but recorded no objective damage. Keep the combat standard and look for a safe objective hit after the next won fight. The damage needs somewhere useful to go once enemy heroes stop volunteering.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Riktor had a rough opening and cleared no wards. Make vision denial a concrete job next game: check the objective approach with a teammate and clear reachable wards before committing. The win is not a reason to leave that part of the support job unfinished.

12.9.call: Mini Prime fell before Murdock killed Phase and Zinx; an outer tower followed the kills. Kill credit does not establish who else was present.

15.3.call: This kill cluster went 1-2. No timestamped positions establish who could join, so the feed cannot justify the old claim that teammates were pinned elsewhere or the fight was a local 5v5.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Manta Scythe and Infernum were equipped. No winning-core comparison exists for Wukong; the missing-magic-resist flag does not establish a costly mistake.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk and Vanquisher match the first two items in the comparison core. Purchase times are estimates, so the report cannot claim an early Vanquisher spike.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Overlord was equipped when the short match ended. Missing later comparison items is not a demonstrated mistake; no observed purchase timing establishes what could have been completed.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings were equipped. Estimated item timings cannot prove the build landed exactly on curve, and this match does not isolate a benefit from replacing either item.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Dynamo and Xenia match two comparison-core items. The inventory alone does not explain the early deaths.

focus.title: Make the objective call before committing
focus.action: Before contesting the next major objective, the shot-caller should confirm who can actually join and call either the contest or a specific cross-map trade.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
enemyKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
enemyKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
enemyKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
enemyKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him
